rules.why: The registration command names the address the page was opened on: the two builds answer on two ports.
The moving particle sphere of an empty chat: it never holds still.
When the background check last ran, which moves by itself.
Each look at this page writes an admin.audit.read row, so its newest rows move with every look, and the header's columns, which the rows size, with them.
The count of rows, which every look raises. Its width moves with the digits, so the whole row it ends is covered, Search and Reset with it.
The pager's total, which every look raises.
The integrity line's unsealed count, which each look raises until the sealer's next turn, and the text after it, which its width moves.
When the server made the report, which the two builds can read a second apart.
When the scan the page shows was made, which the two builds can read a second apart.
When the server summed the reports, which the two builds can read a second apart.
